issues.quote: For myself, I'd have left the Academy long ago, Agnes.
I have no plan B except to continue my studies at the Academy
letting you live in Seraph on an ever grander footing
the Card covered even such expenses as designer outfits and cozy houses
And as long as you stayed at the Academy, you might never have to pay interest on a debt that grew endlessly.
from the second circle on, a mage could already work in full; from the fourth, however, you could say goodbye to any hope of paying off your debts.
Only accredited Academicians kept by Seraph could afford those.
